title: Sprint legs on a marathon
purpose: Maintain rapid, bounded delivery without sacrificing the project's long-run evidentiary, direct-voice, non-link, counterpower, and regression obligations.

sprint_legs.name: freeze
sprint_legs.contract: Freeze source set, time window, identities, maximum ceilings and ordinary alternatives before synthesis.

sprint_legs.name: standalone
sprint_legs.contract: Advance at least one standalone actor or system story without importing overlap claims.

sprint_legs.name: overlap
sprint_legs.contract: Adjudicate at least one exact bridge and preserve at least one non-link or missing bridge.

sprint_legs.name: affected_people
sprint_legs.contract: Advance one deployment-specific direct-voice or represented-person chain, or record the exact deficit and lawful route.

sprint_legs.name: answer
sprint_legs.contract: Advance one observed counterpower, remedy, exit, co-governance or value-recovery case.

sprint_legs.name: ecology
sprint_legs.contract: Repair one source-health, provenance, compiler, interface or regression weakness.

sprint_legs.name: ship
sprint_legs.contract: Publish deterministic outputs, run release gates, reconcile live issues and preserve boundaries.

exit_criteria: every new proposition has a terminal disposition, falsifier and stopping rule
at least one attractive link is either closed exactly or preserved as a visible non-link
standalone and overlap stories remain separately composable
direct voice is deployment-specific and privacy-bounded
at least one answer case includes an observed outcome rather than a formal promise
source failures remain in the denominator and receive a repair route
no sprint output promotes its own claim

maintenance_cycles.daily: M-04G freshwater arcs and artifact-only observations
maintenance_cycles.weekly: source-health review, blocked-route repair and stale-source reconciliation
maintenance_cycles.fortnightly: M-05 bounded story and answer sprint
maintenance_cycles.quarterly: M-04B/M-04F adversarial self-trial and waterline reset
maintenance_cycles.annual: completion-standard review against R0-R7 across domains and jurisdictions

definition_of_done.project_done_when: A repeatable answer to power asymmetry reaches observed pre-action standing, evidence access, independent pause, effective remedy, durable substitution or co-governance, and value recovery across at least three domains and two jurisdictions without exporting equivalent asymmetry elsewhere.
